```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

diag <- params$diag
out_dir <- params$out_dir

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b

md_kable <- function(x, digits = 4, escape = FALSE) {
  if (!is.data.frame(x) || nrow(x) == 0) return(knitr::kable(data.frame(note = "(empty)")))
  knitr::kable(x, digits = digits, escape = escape)
}

# Column dictionary used for the legends printed below every table.
# Notation follows the diagFDR paper: alpha = FDR threshold, T/D = accepted
# targets/decoys (q <= alpha), w = relative window width.
col_def <- c(

  "D/T" = "recomputed decoy ratio D<sub>&alpha;</sub>/T<sub>&alpha;</sub> on this list (derived check: &asymp; &alpha; when the q-values were counted on this list; a larger value signals a scope mismatch). Not an estimate of the realised error",

  CV_benchmark = "FDP-CV benchmark &radic;2&middot;D<sub>&alpha;</sub><sup>&minus;1/2</sup>: approximate coefficient of variation of the realised FDP (Proposition 1 of the paper; assumes equal chance, independent units and decoys displacing incorrect matches only; dependence and heavy-tailed null scores increase it)",
  "FDP-CV bench." = "FDP-CV benchmark &radic;2&middot;D<sub>&alpha;</sub><sup>&minus;1/2</sup>: approximate coefficient of variation of the realised FDP (Proposition 1 of the paper; dependence and heavy-tailed null scores increase it)",

# Keep "--" literal in HTML text (pandoc would turn it into a dash).
nodash <- function(s) gsub("--", "&#45;&#45;", s, fixed = TRUE)

# Write non-ASCII characters as HTML entities, so that text built in R (with
# Greek letters and symbols) displays correctly whatever the session encoding.
html_ent <- function(s) {
  vapply(s, function(z) {
    if (is.na(z)) return("")
    cps <- utf8ToInt(enc2utf8(z))
    if (anyNA(cps)) return(z)
        paste0(ifelse(cps > 127, sprintf("&#%d;", cps), vapply(cps, intToUtf8, "")), collapse = "")
  }, "", USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

# Interpretation text from the package is plain ASCII (pi0, alpha, <=, >=, ~);
# turn it into HTML with symbols.
txt_html <- function(s) {
  s <- htmltools::htmlEscape(s)
  s <- gsub("&lt;=", "&le;", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("&gt;=", "&ge;", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub(" ~ ", " &asymp; ", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("\\bpi0\\b", "&pi;<sub>0</sub>", s, perl = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("\\balpha\\b", "&alpha;", s, perl = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("D_b/T_b", "D<sub>b</sub>/T<sub>b</sub>", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("N_D", "N<sub>D</sub>", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("N_T", "N<sub>T</sub>", s, fixed = TRUE)
  html_ent(nodash(s))
}

# Numbers: small values in scientific notation (e.g. IPE = 6.2e-05, window
# width 2e-05) instead of being rounded to 0; others rounded to `digits`.
fmt_num <- function(v, digits = 3) {
  if (length(v) != 1) return(vapply(v, fmt_num, "", digits = digits))
  if (is.na(v)) return("NA")
  if (is.infinite(v)) return(if (v > 0) "Inf" else "-Inf")
  if (v == 0) return("0")
  if (abs(v) < 1e-300) return("<1e-300")
  if (abs(v) < 1e-3) return(formatC(v, format = "e", digits = 2))
  if (abs(v) < 1) return(formatC(v, format = "fg", digits = digits, flag = "#"))
  formatC(v, format = "f", digits = 2)
}
fmt_table <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  x <- as.data.frame(x, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (nm in names(x)) {
    v <- x[[nm]]
    if (is.numeric(v) && !all(is.na(v) | (is.finite(v) & v == round(v)))) x[[nm]] <- fmt_num(v, digits = digits)
    else if (is.character(v)) x[[nm]] <- nodash(v)
  }
  x
}

# Print a table followed by a legend of its columns (call in results='asis' chunks).
show_table <- function(x, digits = 3, note = NULL) {
  if (!is.data.frame(x) || nrow(x) == 0) { cat("\n(empty table)\n\n"); return(invisible(NULL)) }
    al <- ifelse(vapply(x, is.numeric, TRUE), "r", "l")
  x <- fmt_table(x, digits = digits)
  cat("\n", paste(knitr::kable(x, format = "pipe", escape = FALSE, align = al), collapse = "\n"), "\n\n", sep = "")
  cols <- unique(names(x))
  def <- col_def[cols]
  cat('<div class="table-legend"><strong>Columns.</strong><ul>\n')
  for (i in seq_along(cols)) {
    d <- if (is.na(def[i])) "see the package documentation" else def[i]
    cat(sprintf("<li><code>%s</code>: %s</li>\n", htmltools::htmlEscape(cols[i]), nodash(d)))
  }
  if (!is.null(note)) cat(sprintf("</ul><p>%s</p></div>\n\n", nodash(note))) else cat("</ul></div>\n\n")
  invisible(NULL)
}

# -------------------------
# Icon rendering (HTML only)
# -------------------------
icon_ok      <- "&#x2713;"          # ✓
icon_caution <- "&#x26A0;"          # ⚠
icon_problem <- "&#x26A0;&#xFE0F;"  # ⚠️

flag_to_html <- function(s) {
  if (is.null(s) || length(s) == 0 || all(is.na(s))) return("n/a")
  s <- as.character(s)

  if (s %in% c("NA", "n/a")) return("n/a")
  if (identical(s, "OK")) return(icon_ok)
  if (identical(s, "NE_two_pass")) return("n/e&nbsp;(two-pass)")
  if (grepl("^NE_", s)) return(paste0("n/e (", gsub("_", " ", sub("^NE_?", "", s)), ")"))
  if (grepl("^(ALERT|PROBLEM)", s)) return(paste0(icon_problem, " ", gsub("_", " ", sub("^(ALERT|PROBLEM)_?", "", s))))
  if (grepl("^CAUTION", s)) return(paste0(icon_caution, " ", gsub("_", " ", sub("^CAUTION_?", "", s))))
  s
}

status_to_html <- function(s) {
  s <- as.character(s)
  if (is.na(s) || s == "" || s %in% c("NA", "n/a")) return("n/a")
  if (s %in% c("NO_ALERT", "VALID")) return(paste0(icon_ok, " No alert"))
  if (s == "CAUTION") return(paste0(icon_caution, " Caution"))
  if (s %in% c("ALERT", "REVIEW_NEEDED")) return(paste0(icon_problem, " Alert"))
  s
}

headline_display <- function(tbl) {
  if (!is.data.frame(tbl) || nrow(tbl) == 0) return(tbl)
  out <- tbl

  flag_cols <- names(out)[grepl("^flag_", names(out))]
  for (cc in flag_cols) {
    out[[cc]] <- vapply(out[[cc]], flag_to_html, character(1))
  }
  if ("status" %in% names(out)) {
    out[["status"]] <- vapply(out[["status"]], status_to_html, character(1))
  }
  out
}

# Prefer package helper if present
if (exists("dfdr_summary_headline", mode = "function")) {
  summary_tbl <- dfdr_summary_headline(diag)
} else {
  summary_tbl <- diag$tables$headline
}

summary_tbl_disp <- headline_display(summary_tbl)

alpha_main <- (diag$params %||% list())$alpha_main %||% NA_real_
pnames <- names(diag$plots %||% list())

# Extract metadata
meta_tbl <- purrr::imap_dfr(diag$objects %||% list(), function(x, nm) {
  meta <- attr(x, "meta") %||% list()
  tibble::tibble(
    list = nm,
    unit = meta$unit %||% NA_character_,
    scope = meta$scope %||% NA_character_,
    q_source = meta$q_source %||% NA_character_,
    q_max_export = meta$q_max_export %||% NA_real_,
        p_source = meta$p_source %||% NA_character_,
    two_pass = if (is.null(meta$two_pass)) NA else meta$two_pass
  )
})

# helper: choose box class from ASCII flag code
flag_class <- function(flag_value) {
  flag_value <- as.character(flag_value)
  if (is.na(flag_value) || flag_value %in% c("NA", "n/a")) return("metric-caution")
  if (flag_value == "OK") return("metric-ok")
  if (grepl("^NE_", flag_value)) return("metric-ne")
  if (grepl("^(ALERT|PROBLEM)", flag_value)) return("metric-problem")
  if (grepl("^CAUTION", flag_value)) return("metric-caution")
  "metric-caution"
}
```

## Overview

This report was generated from the output of the `dfdr_run_all()` function of the `diagFDR` R package.

- **diagFDR version:** `r as.character(utils::packageVersion("diagFDR"))`
- **Created:** `r as.character(Sys.time())`
- **Headline threshold (alpha_main):** `r alpha_main`
- **Number of lists analyzed:** `r length(diag$objects)`

---

## Executive Summary

```{r executive, results='asis'}
has_flags <- all(c("status", "interpretation") %in% names(summary_tbl))

if (!has_flags) {
  cat('<div class="alert-info">\n')
  cat('<p><em>Automated flagging not available in this version. Please review metrics manually.</em></p>\n')
  cat('</div>\n\n')
} else {

  cat('<p><em>Flags are review alerts on internal target-decoy diagnostics (specification and internal consistency). They are not a pass/fail verdict: decoy validity, and hence the realised error, needs external evidence such as entrapment. "n/e" marks a check that is not evaluable on this export. Each alert is tagged with its evidential basis: [derived check], [simulation-informed alert] or [heuristic alert] (see dfdr_alert_basis()).</em></p>\n')

  problems <- summary_tbl |>
    dplyr::filter(status %in% c("ALERT", "REVIEW_NEEDED")) |>
    dplyr::pull(list)

  cautions <- summary_tbl |>
    dplyr::filter(status == "CAUTION") |>
    dplyr::pull(list)

  valid <- summary_tbl |>
    dplyr::filter(status %in% c("NO_ALERT", "VALID")) |>
    dplyr::pull(list)

  if (length(problems) > 0) {
    cat('<div class="alert-danger">\n')
    cat('<h3>ALERTS TO REVIEW</h3>\n')
    for (lst in problems) {
      row <- summary_tbl |> dplyr::filter(list == lst)
      row_disp <- summary_tbl_disp |> dplyr::filter(list == lst)

      cat(sprintf('<p><strong>List "%s":</strong> %s</p>\n', lst, nodash(row$interpretation)))
      cat('<ul>\n')

      if ("flag_FDR" %in% names(row) && !is.na(row$flag_FDR) && row$flag_FDR != "OK" && row$flag_FDR != "NA") {
        cat(sprintf('<li>[derived check] Recomputed decoy ratio: %s (D/T = %.2f%% at alpha = %.3g)</li>\n', row_disp$flag_FDR, row$FDR_hat * 100, row$alpha))
      }
      if ("flag_IPE" %in% names(row) && !is.na(row$flag_IPE) && row$flag_IPE != "OK" && row$flag_IPE != "NA") {
        if ("IPE" %in% names(row) && is.finite(row$IPE)) {
          cat(sprintf('<li>[heuristic alert] Decoy-reference PEP concordance: %s (IPE = %s)</li>\n', row_disp$flag_IPE, fmt_num(row$IPE, 3)))
        } else {
          cat(sprintf('<li>[heuristic alert] Decoy-reference PEP concordance: %s</li>\n', row_disp$flag_IPE))
        }
      }
      if ("flag_equalchance" %in% names(row) && !is.na(row$flag_equalchance) && grepl("^(ALERT|PROBLEM|CAUTION)", row$flag_equalchance)) {
        if ("effect_abs" %in% names(row) && is.finite(row$effect_abs)) {
          cat(sprintf('<li>[simulation-informed alert] Equal chance (paired competition): %s (|effect| = %.3f)</li>\n', row_disp$flag_equalchance, row$effect_abs))
        } else {
          cat(sprintf('<li>[simulation-informed alert] Equal chance (paired competition): %s</li>\n', row_disp$flag_equalchance))
        }
      }
      if ("flag_Dalpha" %in% names(row) && !is.na(row$flag_Dalpha) && row$flag_Dalpha != "OK" && row$flag_Dalpha != "NA") {
        cat(sprintf('<li>[simulation-informed alert] Decoy support: %s (D_alpha = %d)</li>\n', row_disp$flag_Dalpha, row$D_alpha))
      }
            if ("flag_Dwin" %in% names(row) && !is.na(row$flag_Dwin) && row$flag_Dwin != "OK" && row$flag_Dwin != "NA") {
        cat(sprintf('<li>[heuristic alert] Local boundary support: %s (D_alpha,win = %d)</li>\n', row_disp$flag_Dwin, as.integer(row$D_alpha_win)))
      }
            fs <- "flag_support"

      if (fs %in% names(row) && !is.na(row[[fs]]) && row[[fs]] != "OK" && row[[fs]] != "NA") {
        cat(sprintf('<li>[simulation-informed alert] Decoy support: %s (D_alpha^-1/2 = %.3f; FDP-CV benchmark = %.3f)</li>\n', row_disp[[fs]], row$support_index, sqrt(2) * row$support_index))
      }
      cat('</ul>\n')
    }
    cat('</div>\n\n')
  }

  if (length(valid) > 0) {
    cat('<div class="alert-success">\n')
    cat('<h3>NO INTERNAL ALERT</h3>\n')
    cat('<ul>\n')
    for (lst in valid) {
      row <- summary_tbl |> dplyr::filter(list == lst)
      meta <- meta_tbl |> dplyr::filter(list == lst)
      cat(sprintf(
        '<li><strong>%s</strong> (%s scope, %s unit): decoy ratio D/T = %.2f%%, D_alpha = %d, FDP-CV benchmark = %.3f</li>\n',
        lst, meta$scope, meta$unit, row$FDR_hat * 100, row$D_alpha, sqrt(2) * row$support_index
      ))
    }
    cat('</ul>\n')
    cat('</div>\n\n')
  }

  if (length(cautions) > 0) {
    cat('<div class="alert-warning">\n')
    cat('<h3>LISTS WITH CAUTION FLAGS</h3>\n')
    for (lst in cautions) {
      row <- summary_tbl |> dplyr::filter(list == lst)
      cat(sprintf('<p><strong>List "%s":</strong> %s</p>\n', lst, nodash(row$interpretation)))
    }
    cat('</div>\n\n')
  }
}
```

## Score Distributions (Target vs Decoy)

<div class="alert-info">
**Interpretation guide:**

- **Score distributions**: Good separation means target distribution shifted right, minimal overlap with decoys
- **q-value distributions (fallback if no scores)**: Target q-values should be concentrated near 0; decoys more uniform. Large overlap suggests poor discrimination.
- **Very few decoys at high scores / low q-values**: Leads to sparse tail support (check D_alpha)

</div>

```{r score-distributions, results='asis'}
score_plots <- pnames[grepl("^score_dist__", pnames)]

if (length(score_plots) == 0) {
  cat("\n(No score distribution plots found; score column may not be available.)\n\n")
} else {
  for (nm in score_plots) {
    list_name <- sub("^score_dist__", "", nm)
    cat(sprintf('\n### %s\n\n', list_name))
    print(diag$plots[[nm]])
    cat('\n\n')
  }
}
```

## Stability Diagnostics

<div class="alert-info">
**What to look for:**

- **D_alpha curve**: Should remain high at operating thresholds (e.g., >50). U-shape indicates granularity at extreme cutoffs.
- **Decoy-support index D<sub>&alpha;</sub><sup>&minus;1/2</sup>**: the FDP-CV benchmark is &radic;2&middot;D<sub>&alpha;</sub><sup>&minus;1/2</sup>, an approximation (equal chance, independent units, decoys displacing incorrect matches only; dependence and heavy-tailed null scores increase it). Index > 0.30 (fewer than about 11 decoys) means the realised FDP is poorly constrained.
- **D_alpha_win**: Local decoy support near cutoff. If it is low (e.g., <20) indicates sparse boundary support.
- **Elasticity** S<sub>&alpha;</sub>(0.2): Jaccard index between the lists at &alpha; and 1.2&alpha;; descriptive (no threshold). A high value (> 0.9) means the list does not rest on borderline identifications.
</div>

## Calibration Diagnostics (target-decoy)

<div class="alert-info">
**What to look for:**

- **Equal chance under paired target-decoy competition**: Decoy fraction in the low-confidence bands should be ~50%. Large deviations suggest scoring bias, but on two-pass exports (second pass on a library reduced by a first pass) the low-confidence region is conditioned and the check is not evaluable.
- **Decoy-reference PEP concordance**: mean target PEP per bin should match the decoy-derived reference D<sub>b</sub>/T<sub>b</sub>. IPE (this comparator) > 0.05 indicates discordance with that reference (an internal check, not calibration against ground truth); it typically arises when run-level PEPs are aggregated across runs.
</div>

## Calibration Diagnostics (p-values)

<div class="alert-info">
This section is shown only when a `p` column is available (true p-values, or pseudo-p-values derived from a score, or from &minus;PEP with `pseudo_pvalue_score = "pep"`).

**What to look for:**

- **p-value density**: Density of p-values associated to decoy should be uniform between 0 and 1. The density associated to targets should be peaky near 0 and decrease between 0 and 1.
- **Calibration plots**: Straight lines have slopes equal to different estimators of "pi0", i.e. the proportion of true null hypotheses (proportion of false identifications). 
For decoys, the slope should be close to 1 (100% of false identifications). For targets, the closer the estimators are to 0, the lower the proportion of false identifications among the targets.
- **Estimated FDR**: This is a proxy of the FDR based on an estimator of "pi0". It should be 100% for decoys. It should increase with the p-value threshold for targets until the value of the "pi0" estimator when the threshold is 1. 
- **pi0 Storey**: Storey's estimator of the proportion of true null hypotheses (incorrect identifications). Should be stable across lambda (flat line).
- **BH elasticity**: High Jaccard (>0.95) indicates stable BH lists. Low Jaccard at operating thresholds suggests sensitivity to cutoff choice.

</div>

### What the p-value diagnostics say

```{r p-interpretation, results='asis'}
pint <- (diag$interpretation %||% list())$p
if (length(pint)) {
  cat('<div class="alert-info">\n')
  for (nm in names(pint)) {
        cat(sprintf('<p><strong>%s</strong></p>\n<ul>\n%s</ul>\n', nm,
                paste0('<li>', txt_html(pint[[nm]]), '</li>\n', collapse = '')))
  }
  cat('</div>\n\n')
    drop_na_cols <- function(d) d[, vapply(d, function(v) !all(is.na(v)), TRUE), drop = FALSE]
  pis <- diag$tables$p_pi0_summary
  if (is.data.frame(pis) && nrow(pis)) {
    cat("\n#### Proportion of true nulls by subset\n\n")
    keep <- intersect(c("list", "subset", "n", "st.spline", "st.boot", "jiang", "histo", "langaas",
                        "pounds", "abh", "slim", "pi0_consensus", "n_converging"), names(pis))
    show_table(drop_na_cols(pis[, keep, drop = FALSE]), note = "&pi;<sub>0</sub> estimators of cp4p::estim.pi0(): Storey with spline smoothing (st.spline) or bootstrap (st.boot), Jiang, histogram (histo), Langaas, Pounds, adaptive Benjamini&ndash;Hochberg (abh), SLIM. Estimators within 0.05 of the median of all estimates converge; the consensus is their median.")
  }
  pth <- diag$tables$p_fdr_thresholds
  if (is.data.frame(pth) && nrow(pth)) {
    cat("\n#### Thresholds giving the target FDR\n\n")
    keep <- intersect(c("list", "subset", "pi0_choice", "pi0", "p_threshold", "n_accepted_target",
                        "n_accepted_decoy", "score_threshold", "pep_threshold"), names(pth))
    show_table(drop_na_cols(pth[, keep, drop = FALSE]), note = "Estimated FDR at a p-value threshold t: &pi;<sub>0</sub>&middot;m&middot;t / #{p &le; t}, as in the Estimated FDR plots; the threshold is the largest t with estimated FDR &le; &alpha;. With &pi;<sub>0</sub> = 1 this is the Benjamini&ndash;Hochberg procedure.")
  }
} else {
  cat("\n(No summary: no p-values were available; see the note below.)\n\n")
}
```

## Appendix: Diagnostic Thresholds

The automated flags use these thresholds. Their evidential basis differs: a *derived check* follows from a stated result, a *simulation-informed alert* was calibrated against ground-truth simulations, and a *heuristic alert* is a practical guideline from the paper's case studies, to be re-derived locally (`dfdr_alert_basis()`).

| Metric | OK | CAUTION | ALERT | Basis |
|--------|----|---------|-------|-------|
| **Recomputed decoy ratio D/T** | <= alpha*1.2 | alpha*1.2--alpha*1.5 | > alpha*1.5 | derived check |
| **D_alpha** | >= 50 | 10--50 | < 10 | simulation-informed alert |
| **Decoy-support index D_alpha^-1/2** | <= 0.15 | 0.15--0.30 | > 0.30 | simulation-informed alert |
| **D_alpha_win** | >= 20 | 5--20 | < 5 | heuristic alert |
| **Decoy-reference PEP concordance, IPE (comparator D_b/T_b)** | <= 0.05 | -- | > 0.05 | heuristic alert |
| **Equal chance under paired competition** \|pi_D - 0.5\| | <= 0.10 | 0.10--0.15 | > 0.15 (n/e on two-pass exports) | simulation-informed alert |
| **Jaccard overlap, threshold elasticity** | -- | -- | -- | descriptive |

These are guidelines for review, not cut-offs. They concern internal consistency only; external validation (e.g. entrapment) is needed to assess decoy validity.
